summary: Backend-only regression + new-feature testing for CareGrid V2 against local FastAPI at http://127.0.0.1:8000. Existing pytest suite (19 tests) all pass. Added 16 new tests covering Care Level recommendation, Real ICU ML model (v2 / deathclassification-icu / 3600 rows / roc_auc~0.84), Real dataset ingestion + idempotency, Capacity Analytics (icu, step_down, services aggregation), ML safety (/ml/estimate range + no side-effects), prioritization weight caps, and bed matching regression. Total 35/35 tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /patients response is a message envelope ({message, patient_id, priority_score}); it does NOT include care_level even though care_level is now a first-class per-patient field. Consider returning the full ranked patient object (including care_level, care_level_note, rank) for a better UX / API ergonomics. Currently clients must GET /patients again.
GET /beds/match/{id} places match_level inside best_match dict and not as a top-level match_quality key — fine, but documenting this in the OpenAPI schema would prevent client confusion.
backend/main.py is 698 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers (patients, beds, datasets, ml, analytics, audit) as new endpoints are added.

success_rate.frontend: not tested (Streamlit — verified by main agent via AppTest)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_-prefixed patients via POST /patients during test runs (unique UUID ids). They persist in SQLite; safe to leave (do not overlap with demo P001-P005). Can be cleaned up if desired but no test asserts against exact patient count.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CareGrid backend runs LOCALLY at http://127.0.0.1:8000 (NOT preview URL, NOT port 8001). Run: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v`. Patient schema uses NUMERIC severity/dependency/deterioration (0..35 / 0..25 / 0..20), required_resources is a STRING (comma-separated), and diagnosis is required. Audit log field is `event` (not `event_type`). Best-match quality lives in best_match['match_level']. Real ICU model v2 already trained on 3600-row deathclassification-icu dataset with roc_auc≈0.84.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All 35 backend tests pass. Real ML model verified (dataset_source contains deathclassification-icu, target=in_hospital_death, n=3600, roc_auc real ~0.84 with confusion_matrix + feature_importance). Capacity analytics returns real services aggregation (ICU/emergency/general_medicine/surgery). ML estimate confirmed pure/no side effects on beds or patients. Care level thresholds honored on all demo patients including P003=ICU Candidate. Prioritization weight caps (35/25/20/10/10) respected.
